recent_en: MILOLO recently opened a flagship store at Ombak KLCC and launched the Bella Astillah blind box product. The company also released its half-yearly results for the period ended 30 September 2026. In addition, its former auditor TGS TW terminated its audit service for the company.
notable_en: MILOLO opened a flagship store at Ombak KLCC and launched the Bella Astillah blind box product.
The company released its half-yearly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
risks_en: Former auditor TGS TW terminated its audit service for the company.
